subject: [PATCH v9 02/32] arm64: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds helpers for PMD (Page Map Directory)-mapped anonymous huge pages on arm64, specifically to support keeping a PMD-mapped THP (Transparent Huge Page) mapped across a swap round-trip. The new helpers wrap the existing PTE (Page Table Entry) ones and reuse the PTE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE flag.
